scenes.event: Henry attends a Sunday service with his father and friend Yuki, seeking clarity in his new faith.
scenes.description: The morning sunlight filters through the stained glass windows of the church, casting colorful patterns on the wooden pews. Henry sits in the back row, slightly apart from his father and Yuki, who sit together in the middle. The atmosphere is quiet and reverent, but Henry feels a mix of anxiety and anticipation as the service begins.

characters.name: Henry Clark
characters.description: A 22-year-old recent convert to Christianity, Henry is thoughtful and anxious, trying to reconcile his new faith with his self-identity. He is seated at the end of the pew, slightly apart from the others.; 22-year-old male, recent convert to Christianity, 24 years old; Occupation: Workplace Newcomer; Personality: Deliberate, Anxious, Exploring, Determined; Values: Faith, Self-discovery, Family Respect; Interests: Spirituality, Philosophical Discussions, Personal Growth; Experiences: Recent religious conversion, College friendships, Family relationships, Faith exploration, Identity

characters.name: James Clark
characters.description: Henry's father, a 50-year-old man with a stoic demeanor and a long-standing, traditional Christian faith. He sits in the middle of the pew, maintaining a silent but imposing presence; Male; Age: 50; Occupation: Senior pastor at St. Michael's Church; Personality: Authoritative, reserved, observant; Values: Faithfulness, tradition, family duty; Interests: Studying scripture, mentoring young church members, gardening; Experiences: Pastoral training in a conservative seminary, leading his congregation through a period of decline, raising Henry in a devout household.

characters.name: Yuki Tanaka
characters.description: Henry's college friend and fellow newcomer to Christianity, Yuki is supportive, curious, and empathetic; Female; Age: 22; Occupation: Environmental Science Student; Personality: Supportive, Curious, Empathetic, Thoughtful, Analytical; Values: Compassion, Personal Growth, Honesty, Community; Interests: Nature walks, journaling, spiritual discussions, volunteering; Experiences: Attended a mission trip to a rural community in Southeast Asia, recently started attending church with Henry, has explored various spiritual practices before committing to Christianity.
characters.position: Middle of the pew, next to James

actions.action: Asks Henry a question during a quiet moment in the service.
actions.dialogue: Hey Henry, are you okay? You seem a bit distracted. Is it the sermon or something else?

actions.action: Responds to Yuki's question with a mix of honesty and hesitation.
actions.dialogue: I don't know... I'm trying to understand how this all fits with who I am. It's not just about believing the right things, is it?

actions.action: Observes the exchange between Henry and Yuki, maintaining silence but showing subtle tension.
Offers reassurance and shares her own experience of questioning faith.
actions.dialogue: I get that. I've been asking myself the same questions. Maybe it's okay to not have all the answers yet.

actions.action: Looks at his father, then back at Yuki, and speaks with a quiet determination.
actions.dialogue: I'm not sure, but I am looking. I want to make sure I'm doing this right, for me and for my family.

scenes.plot: Henry struggles to find his place in the Christian faith during a Sunday service, with his father's silent authority and Yuki's supportive but curious presence. Through their interaction, Henry begins to articulate his internal conflict and determination to explore his beliefs honestly.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore Henry's internal conflict between his new faith and his identity, while also showing his relationship with his father and his friend Yuki's role in his spiritual journey.

chunk.text: Henry sits in the back of the church, his father and Yuki nearby. The service is calm, but Henry's mind is racing. Yuki notices his distraction and gently asks if he's okay. Henry shares his doubts about how his faith aligns with his sense of self, and Yuki reassures him that uncertainty is a natural part of the journey. James, though silent, watches the exchange closely, his presence a reminder of the expectations Henry feels. Henry finally says, 'I'm not sure, but I am looking,' signaling a moment of personal growth and openness.
